name: agent-works
description: Agent workflows rot the same way in every repo: a bloated AGENTS.md, the same rule stated four times, task state in six places, and no word between sessions sharing one machine. agent-works gives each kind of fact one home under .agents/ with a size budget, checks them with one command (aw doctor), keeps tasks and owed gates on a kanban board you and the agents share, guards the files and runs that need it, and coordinates locks, leases and learnings across projects through the aw CLI.

kanbanDir.title: Kanban folder
kanbanDir.description: Where cards are kept, relative to the repository root, when the project's .agents/agent-works.json does not name a folder (paths.kanban).

startMode.title: Starting a task
startMode.description: What dropping a card into the in-progress column does on a board with no setting of its own: open a new session, or queue it for this one.

syncIntervalSeconds.title: Remote sync interval
syncIntervalSeconds.description: Seconds between pulls from GitHub/GitLab on a board with remote sync enabled.
